parsed.rationale: Both `ShowContainerProtocol` (in `_Plant_ShowContainer.swift:19`) and `TrackContainerProtocol` (in `_Plant_TrackContainer.swift:19`) share three identical members — `isStale:Bool`, `lastRefreshedAt:Date?`, and `pageToken:String?` — and differ only in the concrete type of `item`: `Show` vs `Track`. This is the canonical PAT pattern: the varying slot (`item`) becomes an `associatedtype Item`, and the three invariant members move to the parent protocol. Neither record carries any restraint flag (`is_test`, `is_mock`, `is_sample_app`, `is_codegen` are all false), so the refactor is safe. Introducing `ContainerProtocol<Item>` eliminates the structural duplication while preserving the distinct concrete semantics of `Show` and `Track` at each call site.
